ORTHOGONAL POLYNOMIALS (p.778)
22.5.7  T_n(x)=xU_{n-1}(x)-U_{n-2}(x)
22.5.8  T_n(x)=\tfrac12[U_n(x)-U_{n-2}(x)]
22.5.9  U_n(x)=S_n(2x)=U_n^*\Big(\dfrac{1+x}{2}\Big)
22.5.10  U_{n-1}(x)=\dfrac{1}{1-x^2}[xT_n(x)-T_{n+1}(x)]
22.5.11  C_n(x)=2T_n\Big(\dfrac x2\Big)=2T_n^*\Big(\dfrac{x+2}{4}\Big)
22.5.12  C_n(x)=S_n(x)-S_{n-2}(x)
22.5.13  S_n(x)=U_n\Big(\dfrac x2\Big)=U_n^*\Big(\dfrac{x+2}{4}\Big)
22.5.14  T_n^*(x)=T_n(2x-1)=\tfrac12C_n(4x-2)\quad\text{(see [22.22]).}
22.5.15  U_n^*(x)=S_n(4x-2)=U_n(2x-1)\quad\text{(see [22.22]).}
Generalized Laguerre Polynomials
22.5.16  L_n^{(0)}(x)=L_n(x)
22.5.17  L_n^{(m)}(x)=(-1)^m\dfrac{d^m}{dx^m}[L_{n+m}(x)]
Hermite Polynomials
22.5.18  He_n(x)=2^{-n/2}H_n\Big(\dfrac{x}{\sqrt2}\Big)\quad\text{(see [22.20]).}
22.5.19  H_n(x)=2^{n/2}He_n(x\sqrt2)\quad\text{(see [22.13], [22.20]).}
Interrelations Between Orthogonal Polynomials of Different Families
Jacobi Polynomials
22.5.20  P_n^{(\alpha-\frac12,\alpha-\frac12)}(x)=\dfrac{\Gamma(2\alpha)\Gamma(\alpha+n+\frac12)}{\Gamma(2\alpha+n)\Gamma(\alpha+\frac12)}C_n^{(\alpha)}(x)
22.5.21  P_n^{(\alpha,\frac12)}(x)=\dfrac{(\frac12)_{n+1}}{\sqrt{\frac{x+1}{2}}(\alpha+\frac12)_{n+1}}C_{2n+1}^{(\alpha+\frac12)}\Big(\sqrt{\dfrac{x+1}{2}}\Big)
22.5.22  P_n^{(\alpha,-\frac12)}(x)=\dfrac{(\frac12)_n}{(\alpha+\frac12)_n}C_{2n}^{(\alpha+\frac12)}\Big(\sqrt{\dfrac{x+1}{2}}\Big)
22.5.23  P_n^{(-\frac12,-\frac12)}(x)=\dfrac1{4^n}\dbinom{2n}{n}T_n(x)
22.5.24  P_n^{(0,0)}(x)=P_n(x)
Ultraspherical Polynomials
22.5.25  C_{2n}^{(\alpha)}(x)=\dfrac{\Gamma(\alpha+n)n!2^{2n}}{\Gamma(\alpha)(2n)!}P_n^{(\alpha-\frac12,-\frac12)}(2x^2-1)\qquad(\alpha\ne0)
22.5.26  C_{2n+1}^{(\alpha)}(x)=\dfrac{\Gamma(\alpha+n+1)n!2^{2n+1}}{\Gamma(\alpha)(2n+1)!}\,xP_n^{(\alpha-\frac12,\frac12)}(2x^2-1)\qquad(\alpha\ne0)
22.5.27  C_n^{(\alpha)}(x)=\dfrac{\Gamma(\alpha+\frac12)\Gamma(2\alpha+n)}{\Gamma(2\alpha)\Gamma(\alpha+n+\frac12)}P_n^{(\alpha-\frac12,\alpha-\frac12)}(x)\qquad(\alpha\ne0)
22.5.28  C_n^{(0)}(x)=\dfrac2n;\quad T_n(x)=2\,\dfrac{(n-1)!}{\Gamma(n+\frac12)}\sqrt\pi P_n^{(-\frac12,-\frac12)}(x)
Chebyshev Polynomials
22.5.29  T_{2n+1}(x)=\dfrac{n!\sqrt\pi}{\Gamma(n+\frac12)}\,xP_n^{(-\frac12,\frac12)}(2x^2-1)
22.5.30  U_{2n}(x)=\dfrac{n!\sqrt\pi}{\Gamma(n+\frac12)}P_n^{(\frac12,-\frac12)}(2x^2-1)
22.5.31  T_n(x)=\dfrac{n!\sqrt\pi}{\Gamma(n+\frac12)}P_n^{(-\frac12,-\frac12)}(x)
22.5.32  U_n(x)=\dfrac{(n+1)!\sqrt\pi}{2\Gamma(n+\frac32)}P_n^{(\frac12,\frac12)}(x)
[Figure 22.6, not fully transcribed: plot of Chebyshev Polynomials T_n(x) for n=1(1)5, axes T_n(x) vertical (-1 to 1) and x horizontal (-1 to 1); five curves labelled T_1..T_5 oscillating between -1 and 1 with n extrema each, all curves converging to the point (1,1) at the right edge.]
